description: On the bed in front of you are three small white furniture parts: a hollow bench-like box, a separate drawer piece, and another small box part. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips the drawer as a right-hand object, and slides it left toward the hollow bench while the left hand comes in to steady the bench as a left-hand object; then the right hand pushes the drawer into the opening until it seats inside, leaving the assembled unit supported by the left hand.
